The heart: the bulge, the icon, and 3 options

#929, your words: in its little icon picture … it doesn’t look the same as when you actually add it … the line bulges out near the bottom of the heart.

Today and heart A (recommended)

Today

Heart A

Top: the lower-left side of the heart, drawn as a white outline so the line is easy to follow. Today it runs dead straight and then turns all at once (circled): that is the bulge. A curves into the lobe gradually. Bottom: the Heart tile on your phone, 2× bigger. Today’s dips in and juts out on each lower side (the little lines). A’s is drawn from the heart itself.

What is wrong now

1 · The bulge near the bottom

Edit Points on PC: today (left) and A (right). The same 8 points; only the second point up from the tip on each side changes.

That point’s handle is tiny and aimed 10° off the straight run coming up from the tip. So the side goes straight, then turns all at once there: a knee. Measured, it bends about 12× more sharply there than anywhere on the lobes (45 against 3.7). In A the handle lies along the side and is longer, and the sharpest bend drops to 2.1.

2 · The icon is a different drawing

The Add-menu icon’s outline (white) laid over the heart you actually get (pink), same size. Right: its lower-left side, close up.

The tile is not drawn from the heart. It is a hand-typed picture in js/addmenu.js, copied from an early draft of the v4.85 heart whose lower handles pointed straight up. So the icon dips in and juts out at that same spot, and it never followed the heart when the heart changed.

The icon fix, so no tile can drift again

Draw each tile from the shape itself, with the same code that already draws the Squircle tile and every shape on pages 2 to 4. Then the tile is whatever the shape is, for good, and a test fails if a tile with a shape behind it is ever hand-drawn again. Six more tiles are hand-typed copies like the heart, so they change too. All seven, on your phone, actual size:

TriangleHeartPlusArrowChevronTrapezoidParallel­ogram

Now

After (every tile drawn from its shape)

What changes: the Triangle and the Chevron get bigger, filling the tile like their neighbours. The Arrow, Trapezoid and Parallelogram get flatter (the arrow goes from 1.4 : 1 to 2 : 1). That flatter shape is what you already get when you tap them: the old icons were drawn taller than the real shapes. The Plus stays the same. The Heart loses its dip.

The Heart tile: outline or filled

Now: the top of your phone’s first Shape page, actual size.

Outline (recommended): every tile drawn from its shape, heart A as a line drawing.

Filled: the same, with the heart tile solid.

Outline keeps the block even, since every tile in it is a line drawing. It keeps one difference: the tile is a line drawing and the heart you add is solid, the same as the square, circle and star tiles next to it. Filled looks exactly like the heart you get, but it is the only solid tile in the block. Either way the shape is now exactly your heart.
